biggest_catch: You must submit the online rebate application within 120 days of purchase — and the amounts are 'up to', so the top tier (like ENERGY STAR Most Efficient) matters.
catches: Rebate application must be submitted online up to 120 days after purchase.
Amounts are 'up to': washer up to $100, electric dryer up to $300 — the highest tiers require ENERGY STAR Most Efficient models.
Induction cooktop $250, refrigerator up to $100, smart thermostat up to $100, dishwasher $30 — qualifying models only.
The appliance purchase is a condition, not an upfront fee.
PSE&G does not publish the exact check-mailing timeline — s3 honestly marked false.
